newsitem.title: USA: Abraxas sets Canadian natgas acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Abraxas sets Canadian natgas acquisition.

text.p: Abraxas Petroleum Corp said Friday it has tentatively agreed to acquire Canadian Gas Gathering Systems Inc for about $85 million.

The acquisition is subject to Abraxas receiving financing on satisfactory terms, the company said, adding it is exploring alternatives with financial advisors. The alternatives include the sale of debt or equity, traditional bank financing or some combination thereof.
Abraxas said Canadian Gas owns producing properties in western Canada, 197 miles of natural gas gathering systems and 11 natural gas processing plants.

As of September 1, it had proven reserves of 10.8 million barrels of oil equivalent composed 91.8 percent of natural gas. The natural gas plants have aggregate gross capacity of 247 million cubic feet per day, 98.3 million cubic feet net to Canadian Gas. In the six months ended June 30, the plants processed an average of 65.8 million cubic feet per day of which 33.7 percent was custom processed for third parties.
In the first half of the year, Canadian Gas had revenues of $10.6 million and earnings before EBITDA of $6.9 million.
